title: China-to-Comoros Solar PV Inverter Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.requirement: EMC and Power Quality Evidence — IEC 62920 and IEC 61000 for Comoros PV Inverter Projects
rows.target_requirement: For Comoros PV inverter projects, EMC and power-quality evidence should be prepared around IEC 62920 for photovoltaic power conversion equipment and the applicable IEC 61000-series emission, immunity, and harmonic-current standards. Publicly confirmed Comoros solar-inverter EMC technical regulations have not been identified in this dataset; exporters should therefore treat EMC as a SONELEC conformity and SONELEC project-review matter, with exact report scope confirmed for each project. Coastal dust, high ambient temperature, enclosure ventilation, cable routing, grounding, and surge-protection design can affect EMC performance and should be addressed in the technical dossier.
target_standards: IEC 62920 — Photovoltaic power generating systems — EMC requirements and test methods for power conversion equipment
IEC 61000 series — Electromagnetic compatibility emission, immunity, harmonics, flicker, and power-quality standards
SONELEC conformity assessment for regulated products where applicable
SONELEC project technical review for grid-connected PV inverter installations
rows.china_equivalent: Chinese PV inverter EMC files commonly rely on GB/T 37408-2021, NB/T 32004, and CNAS laboratory reports. These documents can support a technical package, but they are not automatically equivalent to IEC 62920 or IEC 61000 evidence for Comoros. If a Chinese report cites IEC test methods, the report edition, test configuration, limits, accessory configuration, firmware version, and laboratory accreditation still need to be checked against the Comoros project requirement.
china_standards: GB/T 37408-2021 — 光伏并网逆变器技术要求 (Technical Requirements for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters) — includes EMC-related requirements
NB/T 32004 — 光伏并网逆变器技术规范 (Technical Specification for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
CNAS-accredited China laboratory EMC test reports
rows.gap: Gap: GB/T 37408-2021 and NB/T 32004 EMC reports should be mapped against IEC 62920 and applicable IEC 61000 clauses. Exporters should obtain or compile IEC-aligned reports for the exact inverter model, power rating, firmware configuration, enclosure option, filters, cables, and accessories supplied to Comoros. Confirm whether SONELEC, SONELEC, EPC contractors, or project owners require ILAC-accredited IEC reports. Do not assume EAC / TR CU EMC certificates are relevant; Comoros is outside the EAEU and domestic conformity plus project acceptance is the controlling route.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory where SONELEC conformity, SONELEC project review, procurement specifications, or project-owner requirements call for IEC-aligned EMC and power-quality evidence
mandatory_status.cn: Chinese EMC evidence may support China domestic conformity or voluntary certification but is not automatically accepted as Comoros IEC-aligned EMC evidence

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Prepare IEC 62920 and applicable IEC 61000 EMC and power-quality evidence for Comoros PV inverter projects instead of relying only on GB/T 37408-2021 or NB/T 32004 files. Confirm the exact EMC report scope with SONELEC, SONELEC, EPC contractor, or project owner, and include coastal dust, heat, grounding, surge-protection, and installation-layout assumptions in the technical dossier.

rows.requirement: SONELEC Grid Connection — 220/380 V 50 Hz, IEC 62116 / IEC 61727, and Project-Specific Settings
rows.target_requirement: Comoros's electricity sector is state-controlled through SONELEC. Grid-connected solar PV inverter projects should be treated as requiring SONELEC technical review, connection conditions, commissioning acceptance, and project-specific protection settings. The national low-voltage supply context is 220 V single-phase / 380 V three-phase at 50 Hz, nominally the same as China. That voltage alignment reduces conversion risk, but it does not replace local grid acceptance. IEC 62116 anti-islanding and IEC 61727 utility-interface evidence should be prepared as the IEC-aligned technical baseline for PV inverters, together with any SONELEC requirements on frequency and voltage protection windows, reconnection delay, reactive power, harmonics, metering, SCADA or monitoring interface, and site commissioning.
target_standards: SONELEC project-specific grid-connection and commissioning requirements for state-controlled electricity supply
IEC 62116 — Utility-interconnected photovoltaic inverters — Test procedure of islanding prevention measures
IEC 61727 — Photovoltaic systems — Characteristics of the utility interface
Project-specific SONELEC settings for protection, metering, reactive power, communications, and commissioning
rows.china_equivalent: Chinese PV inverter grid evidence commonly includes GB/T 19964-2024, NB/T 32004, GB/T 37408-2021, domestic anti-islanding test results, and China grid-operator acceptance files. China also uses a 220/380 V, 50 Hz nominal grid, so basic voltage and frequency are aligned with Comoros. However, Chinese grid certificates and settings are not SONELEC approvals and do not prove compliance with Comoros project-specific protection, commissioning, communications, or owner requirements.
china_standards: GB/T 19964-2024 — 光伏发电站接入电力系统技术规定 (Technical Requirements for Connecting Photovoltaic Power Station to Power System)
NB/T 32004 — 光伏并网逆变器技术规范 (Technical Specification for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
GB/T 37408-2021 — 光伏并网逆变器技术要求 (Technical Requirements for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
rows.gap: Gap: China GB/T and NB/T grid files are supporting documents only. Exporters should prepare IEC 62116 and IEC 61727 evidence, an inverter firmware and protection-setting record for Comoros 220/380 V 50 Hz operation, and a SONELEC project submission package covering protection coordination, harmonics, reactive power, metering, monitoring interface, commissioning tests, and installer responsibilities. Because public PV rules are limited and solar deployment is nascent in a developing island economy, confirm the applicable SONELEC body and project approval path directly rather than assuming any standard EAEU, EAC, or TR CU route.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory for grid-connected PV projects where SONELEC project acceptance applies; public requirements are limited and project-specific connection terms should be obtained directly from SONELEC
mandatory_status.cn: Chinese grid-connection evidence may satisfy China domestic grid-operator expectations but is not transferable to SONELEC project acceptance

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Comoros's 220/380 V 50 Hz grid aligns nominally with China, but Chinese GB/T 19964-2024, NB/T 32004, and GB/T 37408-2021 documents do not replace SONELEC grid acceptance. Prepare IEC 62116 / IEC 61727 evidence and validate firmware, protection, metering, harmonics, reactive-power, communications, and commissioning settings for the exact Comoros project. Do not use an EAC / TR CU route: Comoros is not an EAEU member.

rows.requirement: Safety and Coastal Environmental Suitability — IEC 62109, SONELEC Conformity, Heat and Dust Derating
rows.target_requirement: PV inverter safety and market-access planning for Comoros should be built around domestic SONELEC conformity assessment and IEC-aligned safety evidence. IEC 62109-1 and IEC 62109-2 are the core international safety standards for power converters and PV inverters. Publicly confirmed Comoros solar-inverter product regulations and designated conformity bodies have not been fully confirmed in this dataset, so exporters should verify the applicable SONELEC route, local representative or importer obligations, customs documentation, labelling, language, and project-owner requirements before shipment. Because Comoros has extreme coastal heat and dust exposure and solar deployment is still nascent, project files should include thermal derating curves, high-ambient operation limits, ingress protection, dust filtration or enclosure design, surge protection, service access, and installation clearance evidence.
target_standards: SONELEC domestic conformity assessment for regulated products where applicable
IEC 62109-1 — Safety of power converters for use in photovoltaic power systems — Part 1: General requirements
IEC 62109-2 — Safety of power converters for use in photovoltaic power systems — Part 2: Particular requirements for inverters
Project-specific coastal heat, dust, ingress-protection, surge-protection, and thermal-derating requirements
Comoros is not an EAEU member — EAC / TR CU certification is not the applicable market-access route
rows.china_equivalent: China evidence commonly includes GB/T 37408-2021, NB/T 32004, factory quality files, CQC or CGC voluntary certificates, and CNAS laboratory reports. These files can support a Comoros technical dossier, but they are not automatic substitutes for IEC 62109-1/-2 type-test evidence or for SONELEC conformity where applicable. Chinese standard operation and factory derating data may not fully cover Comoros coastal dust, high ambient temperature, solar irradiance, and maintenance constraints unless separately tested or documented.
china_standards: GB/T 37408-2021 — 光伏并网逆变器技术要求 (Technical Requirements for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
NB/T 32004 — 光伏并网逆变器技术规范 (Technical Specification for Photovoltaic Grid-Connected Inverters)
GB/T 19964-2024 — 光伏发电站接入电力系统技术规定 (Technical Requirements for Connecting Photovoltaic Power Station to Power System)
CQC / CGC voluntary China PV inverter certification schemes where obtained
rows.gap: Gap: A China-only safety dossier should be supplemented with IEC 62109-1/-2 reports, SONELEC conformity documents where applicable, and a high humidity -environment suitability file. Include high-temperature operating range, thermal derating curves, enclosure ingress protection against dust, heat-sink and ventilation assumptions, surge-protection coordination, corrosion and UV exposure assumptions, installation clearances, maintenance intervals, and firmware or shutdown behaviour at high ambient temperatures. Confirm the applicable SONELEC body, local importer obligations, and any project-owner safety specifications directly because publicly available PV-specific rules are limited.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory where SONELEC conformity, SONELEC project review, procurement specifications, insurer requirements, or project-owner requirements call for IEC 62109 and high humidity -environment suitability evidence
mandatory_status.cn: GB/T and NB/T evidence may support China domestic conformity or voluntary certification but does not automatically satisfy Comoros IEC and project environmental requirements

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Do not rely on China-only GB/T 37408-2021 or NB/T 32004 safety evidence for Comoros PV inverter acceptance. Prepare IEC 62109-1/-2 evidence, verify the domestic SONELEC conformity route, and add coastal heat and dust derating documentation for the exact installation environment. EAC / TR CU certification is not the applicable route because Comoros is not an EAEU member.
